ownership.quote: Infrastructure for managing GPU clusters for training/serving. Founded in 2023 by Andrew Aikawa and Roanak Baviskar, Trainy has 3 employees based in San Francisco.

stage.quote: Trainy raised $500K in a seed funding round in September 2023 backed by Y Combinator to build infrastructure for managing and optimizing GPU clusters.
